items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: I didn't know Jimmy Dupree wrote the right to this. As a matter of fact, I wasn't sure that it was published.

ctx.x: Yeah, ask Allison to get it.
I thought Jimmy Dupree wrote that. Oh no, no, Jimmy Dupree. Wrote the words or something. No. Jimmy Dupree used to write all lyrics. Yeah, lyrics, that's what I mean.
Yeah, he wrote all the lyrics, yeah. And what about, did you know Steve Lewis who played piano with Piron?
